items.t: Said it is vital to continue providing the next generation of Iowans with STEM education and resources.
items.q: It is vital that we continue to provide the next generation of Iowans with the STEM education and resources they need to lead this industry into the future.

items.t: Said hands-on STEM projects help middle schoolers develop confidence, curiosity, and problem-solving skills.
items.q: When students get to build and create in hands‑on ways, they develop confidence, curiosity, and problem‑solving skills that will carry them into high school and beyond.

items.t: Said student service projects will build communication, teamwork, initiative and problem-solving skills.
items.q: Students learn leadership by serving others and these projects will directly build their communication, teamwork, initiative and problem solving skills.

items.t: Said she stands firmly with Iowa farmers as they navigate current challenges.
items.q: This resolution sends a clear message that we stand firmly with our farmers as they navigate today’s unique challenges, ensuring that Iowa remains at the forefront of global innovation.

items.t: Said she endorses Randy Feenstra for governor.
items.q: I'm proud to endorse Randy Feenstra for governor because I know he delivers for Iowa," Cournoyer said.

record.t: Announced that Blessed Maria Assunta Pallotta is a recipient of the 2026 NLGA Lt. Governors STEM Scholarship Program.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Chris Cournoyer has announced that Blessed Maria Assunta Pallotta is an award recipient of the 2026 NLGA Lt. Governors STEM Scholarship Program.

record.t: Was appointed Lieutenant Governor of Iowa by Governor Kim Reynolds in December 2024, after representing Clinton, Jackson, and Scott counties in the Iowa State Senate.
record.q: Chris Gearhart Cournoyer is the 48th Lieutenant Governor of Iowa. Before being appointed by Governor Kim Reynolds in December of 2024, she represented Clinton, Jackson, and Scott counties in the Iowa State Senate.

record.t: Served as vice chair of the State Government Committee.
record.q: She was also Chair of the Education Budget Committee, Vice Chair of the State Government committee

record.t: Was elected to the Iowa Senate in 2018.
record.q: Cournoyer, a resident of LeClaire, Iowa, was elected to the Iowa Senate in 2018.

record.t: Wrote and managed legislation that made Iowa the sixth state to protect consumer data in law, while chairing the inaugural Technology committee.
record.q: She chaired the inaugural Technology committee, from which position she wrote and managed the legislation that made Iowa the sixth state in the nation to protect consumer data in law.

record.t: Announced, with a bipartisan coalition of lieutenant governors, the passage of a national resolution recognizing the impact of American agriculture on the global economy and food security.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Chris Cournoyer, alongside a bipartisan coalition of lieutenant governors from across the country, announced the passage of a national resolution recognizing the critical impact of American agriculture on the global economy and food security.

record.t: Co-sponsored a National Lieutenant Governors Association resolution on American agriculture.
record.q: The resolution, passed during a recent meeting of the National Lieutenant Governors Association (NLGA), was co-sponsored by Lt. Gov. Cournoyer (IA), Indiana Lt. Gov. Micah Beckwith

record.t: Announced the STEM BEST® 250 initiative at the BEST STEMposium in early June.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Chris Cournoyer announced the STEM BEST® 250 initiative at the BEST STEMposium in early June.

record.t: Was appointed Lieutenant Governor of Iowa, having previously served as a state senator.
record.q: issued the following statement congratulating State Senator Chris Cournoyer on her appointment as Lieutenant Governor of Iowa:

record.t: Served in the Iowa Senate before becoming Lieutenant Governor.
record.q: Lieutenant Governor Cournoyer and I worked closely in the Iowa Senate to grow our economy and advance our conservative values.
